assignments.name: splunk_link

value.description:
={{ 
'🚨 [' + $json.severity.toUpperCase() + '] ' +
$json.alert_name +

($json.user 
  ? ' | User: ' + $json.user 
  : '') +

($json.attempts > 1 
  ? ' | Attempts: ' + $json.attempts 
  : '') +

($json.filename 
  ? ' | File: ' + $json.filename 
  : '') +

($json.file_name 
  ? ' | Sample: ' + $json.file_name 
  : '') +

($json.vt_score > 0 
  ? ' | VT: ' + $json.vt_score + '/100' 
  : '') +

($json.vt_label && $json.vt_label !== 'unknown'
  ? ' | Threat: ' + $json.vt_label 
  : '') +

($json.suspicious_flag 
  ? ' | Flag: ' + $json.suspicious_flag 
  : '') +

($json.suspicious_process 
  ? ' | Process: ' + $json.suspicious_process 
  : '') +

($json.parent_process
  ? ' | Parent: ' + $json.parent_process 
  : '') +

($json.process_path
  ? ' | Path: ' + $json.process_path 
  : '') +

($json.CommandLine 
  ? ' | Cmd: ' + $json.CommandLine.substring(0, 80) + '...' 
  : '') +

($json.host 
  ? ' | Host: ' + $json.host 
  : '') +

($json.src_ip && $json.src_ip !== "0.0.0.0"
  ? ' | Src IP: ' + $json.src_ip 
  : '') +

($json.dest_ip 
  ? ' | Dest: ' + $json.dest_ip + 
    ($json.dest_port ? ':' + $json.dest_port : '') 
  : '') +

($json.http_method 
  ? ' | Method: ' + $json.http_method 
  : '') +

($json.uri 
  ? ' | URI: ' + $json.uri 
  : '') +

($json.status_code 
  ? ' | Status: ' + $json.status_code 
  : '') +

' | ' + $json.mitre_tactic +
' (' + $json.mitre_technique + ')'
}}
